llm.evidence: coupled with the high resolution nano-ESI Orbitrap-Elite mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific).
LC/MS was performed in hUAs before and after the application of the decellularization method.
Finally, trypsinization of proteins (trypsin ratio 1:100, Sigma-Aldrich, Darmstadt, Germany), centrifugation at 16,000 g for 10 min, and lyophilization were performed.
Normalized collision energy was set to 33 and the precursor ions were excluded for final activation (45 s, 5 ppm mass tolerance).
A sample reduction with 10 mM DTE for 20 min at room temperature (RT), was performed.
Protein alkylation was performed with 0.05 M iodoacetamide in an urea buffer for 20 min at RT.
